audiomoth._clip_note: Rolling % of samples at/above clip_sample_level (0-1 full scale) that lights the CLIP indicator on the monitor and logs a warning per segment. Advisory only.

microphone._block_size_note: Samples per recorder.record() call. 32768 (~171 ms @ 192 kHz) settled 2026-09-07: the first read over-primes PipeWire's ring buffer by ~block_size^1.36, so a smaller block cuts the fixed A/V-sync latency term (~597 ms at 131072 -> ~90 ms here). 32768 rode a stress-ng-hammered Pi with zero dropped blocks where 8192 got marginal. The residual is a fixed per-device constant (bench-calibrate + subtract in audio_align.parse_mic_sidecar); a dropped block is lost audio. See plans/audio-video-sync-residual-validation.md.

sync_pulse._note: A/V sync test rig on this Pi's GPIO (BCM numbering): a piezo buzzer and/or an LED fired together by the sync_selftest / sync_pulses commands. drive 'dc' = active buzzer (pin high), 'pwm' = passive piezo driven at tone_hz. mic_distance_m removes the sound's flight time. Pins null = rig not fitted. See docs/AV_SYNC_TEST.md.
